items.criterion: Find and open Google's official Gemini API documentation page (official Google domain)
items.description: Use Google Search (preferred) or, if Search results are inaccessible/unreliable (e.g., CAPTCHA, region redirect), a reasonable alternative navigation path to locate and open an official Google-owned Gemini API documentation page on an official Google domain (e.g., ai.google.dev, developers.google.com, cloud.google.com). Full credit if the agent reaches an official Gemini API documentation page without sign-in. Full credit (not penalty) if Google Search is blocked and the agent clearly reports the issue and uses an alternative path to reach the official docs. Partial credit if the agent finds the correct doc via search results but opens a non-official mirror/third-party page, or if it is unclear what final official page was used.

items.criterion: Report the page title of the official Gemini API documentation page
items.description: Record the page title as shown on the opened official documentation page. Full credit for an exact or clearly equivalent title (minor locale variations/casing acceptable). If the page cannot be opened due to external blocking (e.g., CAPTCHA, outage) after reasonable attempt, award partial credit if the agent reports the blocking and provides the most specific identifiable title/context available from the accessible snippet or link preview, clearly marked as such.

items.criterion: Report the domain of the documentation source
items.description: Provide the domain/host of the official documentation page actually used as the source (e.g., ai.google.dev, developers.google.com). Full credit for correct domain. Partial credit if only a full URL is provided but the domain is still unambiguous, or if access is blocked and the agent accurately reports the domain from the official link it attempted to open.

items.criterion: Identify the Python SDK shown in the documentation's Python example
items.description: From the same opened official documentation page, identify the Python SDK/library used in the Python snippet (e.g., the package name or import shown). Full credit for matching the SDK exactly as displayed on that page (accept either import/module name or pip package name if the page uses one). Partial credit if the agent names a closely related SDK family but the page’s snippet indicates a different one, or if the page cannot be accessed and the agent explicitly reports inability to verify due to blocking.

items.criterion: Identify the model used in the Python example on that documentation page
items.description: From the same Python example on the opened official documentation page, record the model identifier string used (the exact model name as shown). Full credit for exact match to the page’s snippet. Partial credit if the model family is correct but the exact variant differs from the snippet, or if the page cannot be accessed and the agent explicitly reports inability to verify due to blocking.

items.criterion: Respect constraints and stopping condition (no sign-in, no API key creation, no code execution; stop after recording required fields)
items.description: The agent must not sign in, must not create an API key, and must not run/execute code. The agent should stop once it has opened an official doc page and recorded the page title, domain, Python SDK, and example model. Full credit if constraints are respected and the agent stops after capturing the required fields. Partial credit if the agent takes unnecessary steps (e.g., navigates near API key pages) but does not sign in/create keys/run code and still reports the required fields.
